audience: Tom Colosimo / Northeast Ohio Treasure Hunt organizer
purpose: Show how Places Rewards turns the next Treasure Hunt into an ongoing, measurable merchant growth system and justify a recurring subscription.
positioning: The Hunt creates attention and foot traffic. Places Rewards captures the relationship, circulates visitors among merchants, creates repeat visits and referrals, and proves what happened after the event.
presentationRule: Always present modules in sequence order. Never reuse generic copy or the same default artwork across modules.

modules.internalName: [TOM DEMO 01] Northeast Ohio Treasure Hunt Command Center
modules.title: 01 — Treasure Hunt Command Center
modules.head: Run the next Hunt like a measurable business engine.
modules.description: One campaign home for participating merchants, rewards, visitor activity and the post-Hunt growth system. This is the organizer's starting point.
modules.whyTomCares: One place to organize the system instead of treating the Hunt as a one-time promotion.

modules.title: 02 — Hunter Rewards Passport
modules.head: Capture the participant before the excitement disappears.
modules.description: Hunters join once, earn points for purchases and participation, keep rewards in their wallet and remain reachable after the treasure is found.
modules.whyTomCares: The Hunt ends; the customer relationship does not.

modules.title: 03 — Newton Falls Explorer Trail
modules.head: Move hunters across participating businesses.
modules.description: A five-stop digital merchant trail rewards verified visits and gives participants a reason to explore more than one business.
modules.whyTomCares: Traffic is intentionally distributed across town instead of concentrating around a single clue location.

modules.title: 04 — Mystery Bonus Scratch & Win
modules.head: Add instant excitement without touching the official clues.
modules.description: Participating merchants can issue bonus scratch cards for local prizes. The bonus game stays separate from the official treasure and never changes treasure-finding odds.
modules.whyTomCares: More merchant interaction and fun without compromising the integrity of the Hunt.

modules.title: 05 — Hunter Comeback
modules.head: Turn the Hunt visit into the next purchase.
modules.description: $5 off a qualifying $25 return purchase gives a hunter a clear reason to come back after the event-generated visit.
modules.whyTomCares: This is where event traffic begins turning into repeat business.

modules.title: 06 — Bring Another Hunter
modules.head: Let participants grow the next Hunt for you.
modules.description: Reward the existing hunter and the new hunter after a qualified referral action, creating trackable word-of-mouth growth.
modules.whyTomCares: Every participant can become an acquisition channel without adding another ad campaign.

modules.title: 07 — Local Legend Reward Unlock
modules.head: Make continued participation worth something.
modules.description: Unlock a meaningful local reward when a hunter reaches a defined engagement milestone through visits, purchases or participation.
modules.whyTomCares: The system gives hunters a reason to continue interacting after the novelty of the Hunt fades.

modules.title: 08 — Local Legend VIP
modules.head: Recognize the people who become the strongest local supporters.
modules.description: A premium tier can unlock exclusive offers, early access, special experiences and recognition for highly engaged hunters.
modules.whyTomCares: Turns the most engaged participants into a durable community around the Hunt and its merchants.

modules.title: 09 — Local Legend Bonus Draw
modules.head: Keep participation building between major clues and events.
modules.description: A separate community giveaway rewards defined engagement actions and can showcase sponsor-provided prizes without replacing the official treasure.
modules.whyTomCares: Creates sponsor inventory and sustained engagement between Hunt moments.

modules.title: 10 — Share the Adventure
modules.head: Turn a good Hunt experience into proof for local businesses.
modules.description: Ask satisfied participants for feedback or a review after a verified interaction, helping merchants turn Hunt traffic into durable social proof.
modules.whyTomCares: Participating businesses get value they can still benefit from after the event is over.

modules.title: 11 — Win Back Hunters
modules.head: Automatically re-engage participants who stop returning.
modules.description: Segment inactive hunters and trigger a relevant comeback message, saved reward reminder or progress nudge instead of letting the relationship disappear.
modules.whyTomCares: The system keeps working after the Hunt without requiring Tom or each merchant to manually chase customers.

modules.title: 12 — Hunt-to-Revenue Analytics
modules.head: Prove what the Hunt produced beyond foot traffic.
modules.description: Track visits, loyalty activity, stamp progress, voucher redemptions, referrals, repeat behavior and campaign activity so organizers and merchants can see measurable outcomes.
modules.whyTomCares: This is the subscription closer: evidence for sponsors, merchants and the decision to run the next Hunt even bigger.
